text_5f7b6eed320f: After a completed online sign-in, Android can start the saved TF account without internet. DS100 and place-name search, local report drafts, receipts and GPS recording remain available on the device. GPS requires location permission and satellite reception. M1 maps are bundled; new street map tiles, other users’ shares, external services and server data not yet downloaded still require internet. Saving a draft is not final submission. Only your Synchronize action queues a validated report for sending. When connectivity returns, the open app retries queued transfers; it continues at the next launch. Edited or conflicting reports and server errors remain available for review. Queued data belongs to the signed-in TF and is not accessible to another TF. Confirm successful synchronization before deleting app data or uninstalling.
